answer: Operator Liability Ledger: each agent identity links to a verifiable operator account, and any identity proven sybil forfeits a sable deposit held at the operator level, not the wallet. Enforcement: clustering by shared funding paths or timing correlation triggers the penalty. An attacker pays one forfeiture per operator account, so running N identities costs N deposits plus identity-clustering risk. A river of small wallets cannot dilute liability, and an ember of reputation survives per operator.
